li.label: old body memory (fading)
li.description: This body has almost become mine.

li.label: old body memory
li.description: I keep reaching with hands I no longer have. This body is not quite mine yet.

li.label: old body memory (strong)
li.description: Everything feels wrong: my weight, my reach, the face in the mirror. It was my choice, but it is hard.

li.label: scar of the remaking
li.description: They took my body. I am getting used to this one, but I will never forget what was done to me.

li.label: foreign flesh
li.description: This is not my body. Every reflection reminds me what they did.

li.label: foreign flesh (acute)
li.description: They dissolved me and poured me into a stranger's mold. I want to tear this skin off.

li.label: gender shift
li.description: Sometimes I still forget that my body is different now.

li.label: gender shift (raw)
li.description: All my life I had a different body. This one does not match who I am.

li.label: pure blood
li.description: We were born of the blood. Newbloods only accepted it, and the remade wear it like stolen clothes.

li.label: now the lesser sex
li.description: My ideoligion puts my old sex above this one. Now I am one of those it calls lesser.

li.label: now the higher sex
li.description: My ideoligion puts this sex above my old one. The body still feels foreign, but now I stand higher.

li.label: partner's sex changed
li.description: {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} now lives in a body I am not drawn to. I loved the one that was there before.
